1.web: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
1.asv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

2.web: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
2.asv: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

3.web: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
3.asv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. [Selah

4.web: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
4.asv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.

5.web: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her”; the Most High himself will establish her.
5.asv: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.

6.web: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
6.asv: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. [Selah

7.web: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
7.asv: They that sing as well as they that dance shall say, All my fountains are in thee.
